title: Capitalize words
statementMd: Return `sentence` with the first letter of every word upper-cased and the rest lower-cased. Words are separated by single spaces.
hints: `word[:1].upper() + word[1:].lower()` handles one word; join them back with `" ".join(...)`.
referenceSolution:
def title_case(sentence):
    return " ".join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].lower() for w in sentence.split(" "))
